refs.queued_start_guard: app/src/server/utils/userQueue.ts (hidden / canBeCrafted re-checked when a queued craft starts)

player_preconditions: crafting queue must have room when a craft is already running
quantity per request 1..10; each requirement needs quantity x requested count in inventory
COOKING output must fit the carried cooking bucket
source.not_checked_by_craftItem: requiredLevel, bloodline and other required* fields gate USE, not crafting

blocking.HIDDEN_OUTPUT: item is hidden; craftItem rejects hidden items
blocking.EVOLUTION_ITEM: parentItemId set; craftItem rejects evolution items
blocking.MISSING_INGREDIENT: a requirement points at an item id that no longer exists; no player can hold it

advisory.HIDDEN_INGREDIENT: an ingredient is hidden; check it has a real acquisition route
advisory.DUPLICATE_INGREDIENT: the same ingredient appears in more than one requirement row; craftItem checks rows independently
advisory.SELF_INGREDIENT: the item is one of its own ingredients
advisory.LEGENDARY_FORGEMASTER_ONLY: LEGENDARY: only FORGEMASTER rank can craft it
advisory.INGREDIENT_ACQUISITION_UNKNOWN: an ingredient is not craftable, hunted, gathered, in shop or traded; the census cannot see quest/AI/chest drops, so confirm its source

flag_legend.DETAIL_NOT_READ: the detail read failed or is missing; recipe unknown
